form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Moreno, under authority of the order of the Senate of September 30, 2026, introduced the following bill; which was ordered read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources

form.official-title: To amend the Mineral Leasing Act for Acquired Lands and the Mineral Leasing Act to increase the State share of oil and gas leasing revenue from acquired lands, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Acquired Lands Revenue Modernization Act.

section.header: Disposition of receipts from oil and gas leases of acquired lands

subsection.header: Mineral Leasing Act for Acquired Lands
subsection.text: Section 6(a) of the Mineral Leasing Act for Acquired Lands (30 U.S.C. 355(a)) is amended, in the first sentence—

paragraph.text: by striking Subject to the provisions of section 35(b) of the Mineral Leasing Act (30 U.S.C. 191(b)), all and inserting All; and
by striking for other receipts and all that follows through such lands and inserting in section 35 of the Mineral Leasing Act (30 U.S.C. 191).

subsection.text: Section 35(a) of the Mineral Leasing Act (30 U.S.C. 191(a)) is amended, in the first sentence—

paragraph.text: by striking , and rentals and inserting (30 U.S.C. 1701 et seq.), rentals; and
by inserting (30 U.S.C. 1001 et seq.), and oil and gas leases under the Mineral Leasing Act for Acquired Lands (30 U.S.C. 351 et seq.) after Geothermal Steam Act of 1970.
